summary: Iteration 12 verified end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12_admin_sales_and_workspace_collections.py — GET /api/collections and /api/collections/summary now return workspace-wide data for any authenticated user (emp3 sees emp2's entries and identical totals to admin); write paths remain properly gated (POST → collector-or-admin, PATCH → owner-or-admin, DELETE → admin-only). PATCH /api/sales/{sid} accepts amount+product+notes+purchase_amount together for admin (profit recomputed = 1500-900=600); owner gets 403 when passing purchase_amount; non-owner non-admin gets 403 on any patch; admin can DELETE any sale, non-admin cannot. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): (a) More tab 'row-collections' visible for both admin and emp3; label 'Due collection' (no '(assigned to you)' suffix for emp3 since no collector set). (b) /sales as admin shows 11 edit-sale pencils; sheet title 'Edit sale', byline '· by <name>', all four fields (own-amount, own-product, own-purchase [admin-only], own-notes) and Save changes + Delete this sale buttons rendered. (c) /collections as emp3: add-collection button hidden, 'Only the assigned collector can add entries.' notice shown, 3 workspace-wide entries visible from other users, Total summary pill visible. (d) /sales as emp3: pencil only on own row, sheet title 'Edit my sale', no own-purchase input, no delete-sale button.
